# CT.GOV - Connecticut's Official State Website

> > Connecticut's comprehensive state portal providing access to government services, tax filing, DMV operations, and emergency preparedness resources.

CT.GOV serves as Connecticut's central hub for state government services, featuring the myconneCT tax filing system, DMV services including REAL ID, and connections to all executive branch departments and agencies. The portal aggregates services across taxation, education, transportation, public safety, environmental protection, and emergency management.

## Key Topics

- Connecticut Government
- myconneCT
- DMV Services
- REAL ID
- Tax Filing
- Governor Ned Lamont
- Lieutenant Governor Susan Bysiewicz

## Core Government Portal

- [CT.GOV - Connecticut's Official State Website](https://portal.ct.gov): Connecticut's official state portal with government services, myconneCT, and REAL ID
- [Most Popular Services](https://portal.ct.gov/most-popular-services): Connecticut's most popular government services and frequently accessed portals
- [CT Government](https://portal.ct.gov/government): Connecticut government portal with departments, agencies, and constitutional offices

## Tax and Financial Services

- [myconneCT](https://portal.ct.gov/drs/myconnect/myconnect): myconneCT tax filing portal for individual and business tax returns
- [CT.gov Revenue Topic](https://portal.ct.gov/services/revenue): Tax services: income tax, business tax, property tax, and myconneCT filing
- [Heating Help - Connecticut Heat Assistance Programs](https://portal.ct.gov/heatinghelp): Connecticut heating assistance programs for utility bill relief and winter protection

## Transportation and Licensing

- [CT.gov Driving and Transportation Topic](https://portal.ct.gov/services/driving-and-transportation): DMV services: driver licenses, vehicle registration, AutoRenew, and transportation
- [Learn how to get a REAL ID | CT.gov](https://portal.ct.gov/dmv/licenses-permits-ids/get-real-id): Guide to obtaining REAL ID for domestic travel and federal building access

## Public Services and Safety

- [CT.gov: Public Safety](https://portal.ct.gov/services/public-safety): Public safety services: state police, firearms, corrections, and emergency management
- [CT Prepares](https://portal.ct.gov/ctprepares): CT Prepares emergency preparedness resources and alerts for Connecticut residents
- [CT.gov Education Topic](https://portal.ct.gov/services/education): Education services: K-12, teacher certification, school choice, and early childhood
- [State Job Openings](https://portal.ct.gov/services/jobs-and-employment/state-job-openings): Connecticut state government job openings and employment opportunities

## Environment, Recreation, and Community

- [Land and Environment](https://portal.ct.gov/services/land-and-environment): Environmental, housing, energy, utilities, and agriculture services
- [CT.gov: Recreation](https://portal.ct.gov/services/recreation): Recreation and tourism: state parks, camping, fishing, and outdoor activities

## State Leadership and Administration

- [Connecticut Governor Ned Lamont | CT.gov](https://portal.ct.gov/governor): Governor Ned Lamont's office with news, initiatives, and constituent services
- [Office of the Lt. Governor](https://portal.ct.gov/lt-governor): Lt. Governor Susan Bysiewicz's office with press releases and services
- [CT.gov: Departments and Agencies](https://portal.ct.gov/government/departments-and-agencies/departments-and-agencies): Directory of Connecticut executive branch departments and agencies
- [Departments and Agencies](https://portal.ct.gov/government/departments-and-agencies): Connecticut state government departments and agencies directory
- [CT.gov: Cities and Towns](https://portal.ct.gov/government/cities-and-towns): Connecticut cities and towns directory with municipal government links

## Optional

- [CT.gov: Disclaimer](https://portal.ct.gov/portal/policies/disclaimer): Connecticut website disclaimer and legal terms of use
